defects.statement: Fleet-health telemetry never observed Bahia-published observables. Publisher.PublishSignedEventWithResults records each signed event in nostr_events before the first relay attempt, and Subscriber.handleEvent skips every handler when Record reports inserted=false, so the relay echo of a self-published event never reached telemetryProvider.ObserveNostrEvent. This affected the existing runtime managed-instance projection as well as the new route projection.
defects.fix: Subscriber gained WithObserver for idempotent read-side projections that run for every validated, durably persisted event regardless of insert state; fleet-health telemetry is registered as an observer while side-effect handlers remain gated.

defects.statement: The fleet-health domain vocabulary was duplicated: boundedFleetDomain and renderNostrFleetHealthMetrics each held their own list, so a domain could be classified without being exported.
defects.fix: Single nostrFleetHealthDomains list read by both classification and rendering.

defects.statement: RouteCanaryGate.record persists gate outcomes, including an immediately opened outage, without publishing an in-process transition, so a gate-declared outage reaches Nostr only when the supervisor next reports a transition for that route.
defects.owner_note: internal/service/route_canary_gate.go is owned by concurrent route canary work (bahia-6xztt / bahia-j9liz) and was deliberately not modified; needs a follow-up bead.

defects.statement: Fleet-health telemetry keeps its projection in memory and the subscriber backfills from the latest persisted created_at, so after a restart subject gauges (all domains, including route) start empty until new observables arrive; a long-running outage is uncounted until its next transition.
defects.owner_note: Pre-existing fleet-health ingestion design; needs a follow-up bead for replaceable-state hydration.

defects.statement: Route state is projected on transition only, so a route whose outage opened before the projector was deployed is projected on its next transition.
defects.owner_note: Resolved together with D4 by a startup projection of current durable route state, or by hydration; needs a follow-up bead.
